stem: Which statement about the number 5,555 is true?

options.label: A
options.text: There is a 5 in the tens place, so 5 times 10 equals 50.

options.label: B
options.text: There is a 5 in the hundreds place, so 5 times 100 equals 50.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a 5 in the tens place, so 5 times 10 equals 500.

options.label: D
options.text: There is a 5 in the thousands place, so 5 times 1,000 equals 500.
